Coil 3.3.0 (coil-core and coil-svg)
Copyright Coil Contributors.
https://github.com/coil-kt/coil/tree/3.3.0
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (LICENSE.txt).
Coil performs fetch orchestration and raster/static SVG decoding. Its native
MemoryCache (64 MiB, weak fallback disabled) and web-only DiskCache (100 MiB)
own reuse; explicit retry uses WRITE_ONLY cache policies. MDive's custom Fetcher
enforces SAF permissions, bounded HTTPS, and image/SVG preflight before bytes
reach a decoder or disk cache. Static SVG decoding uses AndroidSVG (../androidsvg).
